solution_title: Reimagining Travel: Personalized Journeys for a New Generation
solution_description: Traditional tourism is facing a challenge: generic experiences that don’t connect with today’s travelers. With MAPT, we address this by offering personalized, data-driven solutions that benefit both travelers and destinations. Our platform empowers travelers with curated, meaningful experiences, while helping destinations better understand and engage their visitors.
for_travelers_title: For Travelers: Go with Your Flow
for_travelers_description: Whether you're a solo adventurer, culture seeker, beach lover, or foodie, MAPT brings your unique travel style to life. No more endless scrolling or generic guides — just effortless experiences tailored to you.
for_destinations_description: In today’s competitive travel landscape, your destination needs to stand out. MAPT provides the tools and insights to help you connect with travelers in a more personalized, impactful way.
destination_benefit1: Connect with travelers based on their true interests and preferences
destination_benefit2: Deliver personalized, real-time experiences that engage visitors from start to finish
destination_benefit3: Capture valuable insights into visitor behavior and trends to improve destination strategies
destination_benefit4: Build loyalty through meaningful, tailored interactions that keep travelers coming back
about_description1: Esther has a BA and MSc in tourism development and an MSc in marketing. She specializes in tourism product design and development, aiming to create memorable travel experiences while promoting sustainability. As a leader at Mapt, she ensures the company meets modern travelers' needs and fosters inclusivity and environmental consciousness, positioning Mapt as a positive force in travel.
about_description2: Supun is an experienced software developer specializing in building scalable systems for the travel industry. He is passionate about leveraging technology to enhance user experiences and streamline operations. He holds a Master’s degree in Computer Science, a Master’s in Strategic Information Systems Management, and a BSc in Information Technology. He is also a Professional Member of the British Computer Society (MBCS), UK.
story_description1: MAPT was created to make travel feel personal, not generic. Frustrated by rigid itineraries and endless research, our founders built a platform that tailors each trip to what makes it unique while helping destination managers understand what attracts tourists. More than just an app, MAPT connects travelers with destinations through technology and human curiosity.
story_description2: Our vision is a world where every traveler enjoys seamless, personalized journeys through one platform. Our mission is to revolutionize travel through innovative technology, delivering seamless, personalized experiences that foster authentic connections between travelers and the destinations they choose.
